data.zh_cn:
硬件短路、软件短路
保护说明及处理方案：电池保护电路短路保护，请即刻停止机器使用，排查存在短路问题的地方，拔除充电器，停止骑行，静置或关机1分钟等排查过后，如果不能恢复正常，需维修处理。
data.en: Hardware short-circuit and software short-circuit protection instructions and solutions: battery protection circuit short-circuit protection, please stop using the machine immediately, check where there is a short-circuit problem, unplug the charger, stop riding, stand or turn off for 1 minute, etc. After checking, if it can't Back to normal, need to be repaired.

data.zh_cn:
充电过流
保护说明及处理方案：电池充电电流超过(参考值:7A)， 请立即停止充电，拔除充电器，等待1分钟左右，机器会自动解除保护 。
data.en: Over-charging protection instructions and solutions: If the charging current of the battery exceeds (reference value: 7A), please stop charging immediately, unplug the charger, wait for about 1 minute, and the machine will automatically release the protection.

data.zh_cn:
放电过流
 保护说明及处理方案：电池放电电流超过(参考值:40A)， 请即刻停止机器工作，或者也可以插入充电器充电，等待10S左右，机器会自动解除保护  。
data.en: Over-discharge protection instructions and solutions: If the battery discharge current exceeds (reference value: 40A), please stop the machine immediately, or you can also plug in the charger to charge, wait for about 10S, and the machine will automatically release the protection.

data.zh_cn:
单体过压
保护说明及处理方案：单体电池电压超出(参考值:4.25V)，请即刻停止充电，移除充电器10S之后，或使机器运转，等待电压低于(4.15V)之后，机器会自动解除保护  。
data.en: Single-cell overvoltage protection description and treatment plan: If the voltage of the single-cell battery exceeds (reference value: 4.25V), please stop charging immediately, remove the charger for 10S, or run the machine, and wait for the voltage to drop below (4.15V), then The machine will automatically release the protection.

data.zh_cn: 总压过放                   保护说明及处理方案：电池总电压低于(参考值:72.0V)，请立即停止机器使用，及时给机器充电，当总电压高于恢复电压(90V)后，机器会自动解除保护。
data.en: Total voltage over-discharge protection description and treatment plan: If the total battery voltage is lower than (reference value: 72.0V), please stop using the machine immediately, and charge the machine in time. When the total voltage is higher than the recovery voltage (90V), the machine will automatically release Protect.

data.zh_cn:
环境低温、环境高温
保护说明及处理方案：电池温度环境温度已经严重超出电池工作的正常温度范围(参考值:-30℃~70℃)，请即刻改善电池所在的环境温度。
data.en:
Ambient low temperature, high ambient temperature 
Protection instructions and treatment plan: battery temperature The ambient temperature (reference value: -30℃~70℃) has seriously exceeded the battery protection limit. Please immediately improve the ambient temperature where the battery is located.

data.zh_cn: 放电高温                   保护说明及处理方案：放电时电池温度高于(参考值:60℃)，请即刻停止机器使用，当温度低于50℃，机器会自动解除保护。
data.en: High temperature discharge protection instructions and treatment plan: When the battery temperature is higher than (reference value: 60°C) during discharge, please stop using the machine immediately. When the temperature is lower than 50°C, the machine will automatically release the protection.

data.zh_cn: 充电高温               	  保护说明及处理方案：电池充电温度超过(参考值:55℃)，请即刻停止充电，等到温度低于50℃，机器会自动解除保护。
data.en: High temperature charging protection instructions and solutions: If the charging temperature of the battery exceeds (reference value: 55°C), please stop charging immediately. When the temperature is lower than 50°C, the machine will automatically release the protection.

data.zh_cn: MOS高温                    保护说明及处理方案：充电或放电电路温度(参考值:95℃)严重高于电池保护限值 ，请即刻停止充电或停止机器使用，等待恢复。
data.en: MOSFET high temperature 												Protection instructions and treatment plan: The charging or discharging circuit temperature (reference value: 95℃) is seriously higher than the battery protection limit, please stop charging or stop using the machine immediately and wait for recovery.

data.zh_cn: 总压过压             	  保护说明及处理方案：充电时总电压高于(参考值:126.5V)，请即刻停止充电，移除充电器10S之后，或使机器运转，等待电压低于(124.5V)之后，机器会自动解除保护  。
data.en: Total voltage and overvoltage protection instructions and solutions: when charging, the total voltage is higher than (reference value: 126.5V), please stop charging immediately, remove the charger for 10S, or run the machine, wait for the voltage to drop below (124.5V) , the machine will automatically release the protection.

data.zh_cn: 单体过放               	  保护说明及处理方案：单体电池电压低于(参考值:2.50V)，及时给机器充电，当单体最小电压高于恢复电压(3V)后，机器会自动解除保护。
data.en: Single-cell over-discharge protection instructions and solutions: If the voltage of the single-cell battery is lower than (reference value: 2.50V), charge the machine in time. When the minimum single-cell voltage is higher than the recovery voltage (3V), the machine will automatically release the protection.

data.zh_cn: 放电低温               	  保护说明及处理方案：放电时电池温度低于(参考值:-20℃)，请即刻停止机器使用，改善电池所在的环境温度，当温度高于于-10℃，机器会自动解除保护。
data.en: Discharge low temperature protection instructions and treatment plan: When the battery temperature is lower than (reference value: -20℃) during discharge, please stop using the machine immediately and improve the ambient temperature where the battery is located. When the temperature is higher than -10℃, the machine will automatically release the protection .

data.zh_cn: 充电低温                	  保护说明及处理方案：电池充电温度低于(参考值:-5℃)，请停止充电，改善电池所在的环境温度，等到温度高于0℃，机器会自动解除保护。
data.en: Low charging temperature Protection instructions and treatment plan: If the charging temperature of the battery is lower than (reference value: -5℃), please stop charging and improve the ambient temperature where the battery is located. When the temperature is higher than 0℃, the machine will automatically release the protection.

data.zh_cn: 采样故障、电芯故障         故障说明及处理方案：保护板电路有故障，请即刻停止机器使用，检查维修。
data.en: Sampling failure, cell failure 										Fault description and solution: There is a failure in the protection board circuit, please stop using the machine immediately, check and repair it.

data.zh_cn: NTC故障                    故障说明及处理方案：温度传感器故障，请停止机器使用，检查维修。
data.en: NTC fault 															Fault description and solution: The temperature sensor is faulty. If it cannot be recovered, it needs to be repaired.

data.zh_cn: 充电MOS故障   故障说明及处理方案：保护板充电路故障 ，请停止机器使用，检查维修。充电MOS故障自动恢复的方法：插上充电器，2~5秒后，正常情况下，故障自动消除。
data.en: Charging MOS fault Fault description and solution: If the charging circuit of the protection board is faulty, please stop using the machine and check and repair. The method of automatic recovery of charging MOS fault: plug in the charger, after 2~5 seconds, under normal circumstances, the fault will be automatically eliminated.

data.zh_cn: 工作电源故障               故障说明及处理方案：保护板工作电源有故障，请即刻停止机器使用，检查维修。
data.en: Working power failure 							                    Fault description and solution: If the working power supply of the protection board is faulty, please stop using the machine immediately and check and repair it.

data.zh_cn: 总压低压                   告警说明及处理方案：总电压(参考值:90.0V~126.2V)偏低(小于90V),请及时充电，等单体电压高于3V，并且总电压高于90V之后，告警会自动消除。
data.en: Total voltage and low voltage alarm description and processing plan: the total voltage (reference value: 90.0V~126.2V) is low (less than 90V), please charge it in time, and when the single voltage is higher than 3V and the total voltage is higher than 90V, the alarm will be displayed. automatically eliminated.

data.zh_cn: 总压过压               	  告警说明及处理方案：总电压(参考值:90.0V~126.2V)偏高(大于126.2V)，请及时停止充电,正常使用即可，等总电压低于126.2V之后，告警会自动消除。
data.en: Total voltage and overvoltage alarm description and solution: the total voltage (reference value: 90.0V~126.2V) is too high (greater than 126.2V), please stop charging in time, and use it normally. After the total voltage is lower than 126.2V, the alarm will be issued will be automatically removed.

data.zh_cn:
MOS高温                    
告警说明及处理方案：请及时确认MOS温度是否高于(参考值:75℃)，首先停止机器工作，停止充电，静待一段时间，当MOS温度小于65℃，告警会自动消除。
data.en: MOS high temperature Alarm description and solution: Please confirm whether the MOS temperature is higher than (reference value: 75°C) in time. First, stop the machine from working, stop charging, and wait for a period of time. When the MOS temperature is lower than 65°C, the alarm will be automatically cleared.

data.zh_cn: 环境低温、环境高温         告警说明及处理方案：电池所处的环境温度超过(参考值:-20℃~65℃)范围，请及时确定机器所处的环境温度，选择合适温度下的的充电或骑行环境。
data.en: Ambient low temperature and high ambient temperature              		    Alarm description and solution: The ambient temperature of the battery (reference value: -20°C~65°C) exceeds the limit, please confirm the ambient temperature of the machine in time, and select the charging at the appropriate temperature or riding environment.

data.zh_cn: 放电低温               	  告警说明及处理方案：骑行或电机运转时电池温度(参考值:-10℃~57℃)低于-10℃，请及时选择合适的骑行或使用环境。
data.en: Discharge low temperature, discharge high temperature             		        Alarm description and solution: The battery temperature (reference value: -10℃~57℃) exceeds the limit, please stop using the machine in time, or reduce the power consumption of the machine.

data.zh_cn: 充电低温               	  告警说明及处理方案：充电时电池温度(参考值:3℃~45℃)低于3℃，请及时停止充电。
data.en: Charging low temperature, charging high temperature               		        Alarm description and solution: The battery temperature (reference value: 3℃~45℃) exceeds the limit, please stop charging in time, or check whether the charging current (reference value: 8A) is too large.

data.zh_cn: 放电过流      		      告警说明及处理方案：请及时确认左右电池的放电电流有超过-35A(负号表示放电)，只要电流小于放电35A，告警可自动消除，
data.en: Discharge overcurrent Alarm description and solution: Please confirm in time that the discharge current of the left and right batteries exceeds -35A (the negative sign indicates discharge). As long as the current is less than 35A, the alarm can be automatically eliminated.

data.zh_cn: 充电过流     		      告警说明及处理方案：请及时确认充电电流(参考值:6A)是否过大(大于6A)，只要充电电流小于6A，或者停止充电，告警可自动消除，
data.en: Charging overcurrent alarm description and solution: Please confirm whether the charging current (reference value: 6A) is too large (greater than 6A) in time, as long as the charging current is less than 6A, or stop charging, the alarm can be automatically eliminated.

data.zh_cn: 单体低压   		          告警说明及处理方案：单体电池电压(参考值:3.000V~4.22V)偏低(小于3V),请及时充电，等单体电压高于3V，并且总电压高于90V之后，告警会自动消除。
data.en: Cell low voltage Alarm description and solution: The single battery voltage (reference value: 3.000V~4.22V) is low (less than 3V), please charge it in time, wait until the single cell voltage is higher than 3V and the total voltage is higher than 90V , the alarm will be automatically cleared.

data.zh_cn: 低电量告警   		      告警说明及处理方案：电量偏低(参考值:10%)，请及时充电，等电池电量高于10%之后，告警会自动消除。
data.en: Low battery alarm Alarm description and solution: The battery is low (reference value: 10%), please charge it in time, and the alarm will be automatically cleared when the battery power is higher than 10%.

data.zh_cn:
单体高压   	  
告警说明及处理方案：单体电池电压(参考值:3.000V~4.22V)偏高(大于4.22V)，请及时停止充电,正常使用即可，等单体电压低于4.22V，告警会自动消除。
data.en: Cell high voltage Alarm description and solution: The single battery voltage (reference value: 3.000V~4.22V) is too high (greater than 4.22V), please stop charging in time, and use it normally, and wait until the single battery voltage is lower than 4.22V , the alarm will be automatically cleared.

data.zh_cn: 放电高温                   告警说明及处理方案：骑行或电机运转时电池温度超过55℃，请及时停止骑行或停止机器使用，当温度低于50℃后，告警会自动消除。
data.en: Discharge high temperature Alarm description and solution: When the battery temperature exceeds 55°C when riding or the motor is running, please stop riding or stop using the machine in time. When the temperature is lower than 50°C, the alarm will be automatically cleared.

data.zh_cn: 充电高温                	  告警说明及处理方案：充电时电池温度超过53℃，请及时停止充电，或加强机器散热，当温度低于53℃后，告警会自动消除。
data.en: Charging high temperature Alarm description and solution: When the battery temperature exceeds 53℃ during charging, please stop charging in time, or strengthen the heat dissipation of the machine. When the temperature is lower than 53℃, the alarm will be automatically cleared.

data.zh_cn: 压差过大 告警说明及处理方案：电池单体最高电压与最低电压压差超过限定(参考值:500mV)范围，请注意检查电芯的健康状态，用专业设备对电池进行均衡或做高压均衡处理。
data.en: Excessive voltage difference alarm description and solution: The voltage difference between the highest voltage and the lowest voltage of the battery cell exceeds the limit (reference value: 500mV), please pay attention to check the health status of the battery cell, and use professional equipment to balance the battery or do high-voltage balance deal with.

data.zh_cn: 低压故障 故障说明及处理方案：：单节电压电压低于2.5V，并且总电压低于最低限值 ，已关闭放电，请充电，正常充电后可自动解除故障。
data.en: Low voltage fault fault description and treatment plan: single section voltage voltage is lower than 2.5V, and the total voltage is lower than the minimum limit value, the discharge has been turned off, please charge, the fault can be automatically relieved after normal charging.

data.zh_cn: 电池内部湿度过高(参考值：90%)，可能有进水或者电池漏液情况，存在安全隐患，请立即检修。
data.en: The internal humidity of the battery is too high (reference value: 90%), which may cause water ingress or battery leakage, posing a safety hazard. Please repair it immediately.

data.zh_cn: 高边电池通讯异常，存在安全隐患，禁止充电，请立即检修
data.en: The high-side battery communication is abnormal, charging is prohibited, posing a safety hazard. Please repair it immediately.
